interaction_adjusted.scope: Joint iid-pair, mixing-calendar, independent-gold first-order limit; fixed error below one half and comparable growth.

inference.sampling_unit: persistent pair and stationary calendar; independent gold labels
inference.coverage_claim: conditional first-order joint asymptotic; comparable pair/calendar growth; nondegenerate projections; sufficient mixing/moments and bandwidth rates
inference.numerical_status: pair mean variance plus Bartlett calendar variance; interaction may be counted twice
inference.information: known inclusion; randomized actions; accurate gold truth and independent symmetric label errors
inference.empirical_qualification: selected synthetic laws; not arbitrary multiway dependence or semantic validation
